evidence: Has the Validation label and handles chainstate directory cleanup and crash recovery for assumeutxo snapshots.
rationale: Fixes an unhandled crash-recovery failure in assumeutxo where an interrupted cleanup leaves a nonempty `chainstate_todelete` directory, preventing the node from completing startup on subsequent runs. Chainstate crash safety and startup reliability are high-priority concerns in validation, making this a clear stability improvement even though it triggers only after an interrupted cleanup.
